name: FUNKY-TRAIN
author: keste
description: An 80s funk machine: 34 original Vibe FM keyboard voices, eight synthesized drum voices, eight driving 16-step grooves, and a funk FX rack with tape sat, comp, EQ, auto wah, Dimension D, chorus, phaser, rotary, analog echo and gated reverb. Keys and MIDI play the synth; pads 1-8 trigger drums and pads 9-16 launch grooves. Bank A lives in a .vforge common source; DX7 SysEx is intentionally not generated from high-level specs.
